confirmation.failure: The action could not be completed. Try again.
confirmation.clearTargetUrlsBody: Remove the configured target URL from the selected keywords. Ranking history is not affected.
confirmation.deactivateAccountBody: Deactivation will block sign-in and revoke every session. It will pause scheduled checks owned by this account. Every personal access token belonging to it will be permanently revoked. Instance administrators are protected.
confirmation.deleteAccountBody: This permanently deletes your account, your projects, and everything tracked in them. This cannot be undone.
confirmation.deleteBulkBody: Remove the selected keywords and their history. This cannot be undone.
confirmation.deleteKeywordBody: Stop tracking this keyword and remove its position history. This cannot be undone.
confirmation.deleteProjectBody: This permanently deletes this project and all tracked keywords, history and API keys. This cannot be undone.
confirmation.deleteRunBody: Delete this run from history? Keyword positions and recorded provider spend are retained. This cannot be undone.
confirmation.deleteWebhookEndpointBody: Stop future deliveries to this endpoint and remove its delivery history association. This cannot be undone.
confirmation.reactivateAccountBody: Allow sign-in again. Previously revoked personal access tokens stay revoked and must be recreated. Scheduled checks will reconverge through the schedule reconciler.
confirmation.removeIntegrationBody: Rank checks will stop until another SERP provider is connected. Stored credentials are removed from this instance.
confirmation.removeSampleDataBody: This deletes the sample project and its generated demo data. Your other projects are not affected.
confirmation.removeSearchConsoleConnectionBody: This removes the saved connection and authorization tokens from this project. Already imported Search Console metrics remain available.
confirmation.removeTeamMemberBody: Remove this member from the project. Their account and access to other projects are not affected.
confirmation.resetAccountLimitsBody: Clear this account's rate-limit buckets. Monthly spend is a rolling window and cannot be reset.
confirmation.revokeKeyBody: Any app or script using this key will stop working immediately. Generate a new key to restore access.
confirmation.revokeMigrationTokenBody: This invalidates the current token. Any transfer using it will no longer work.
confirmation.rollMigrationTokenBody: This invalidates the current token. Any transfer using it will no longer work.
confirmation.transferProjectOwnershipBody: Make this member the project owner. Your project role changes to admin, and only the new owner can transfer ownership again.

planned.description: The run waits for its scheduled time.

blocked.description: A problem, such as a used-up budget or a missing provider, stops the run.

queued.description: The run is accepted and waits for its first check.

running.description: The run is checking its targets.

cancelling.description: The run stops when its started checks finish.

partial.description: Some targets got a result, and others did not.

deferred.description: The run postponed its targets and charged nothing for them.

failed.description: No target got a result because its checks failed or were skipped.

cancelled.description: The run stopped on request and keeps the results it already got.

not_confirmed.description: The run finished, but it has no recorded result.
